dedupe_keys.name: helcats arrcat 2 0 arrival catalogue of coronal mass ejections observed with stereo heliospheric imagers

description: ARRCAT lists modelled arrivals of solar coronal mass ejections at planets and spacecraft for CMEs tracked with the STEREO heliospheric imagers and covers April 2007 to February 2025. It holds 3,096 arrival events at targets including Earth L1, Mercury, Venus, Mars, STEREO-A and B, Solar Orbiter, Parker Solar Probe, BepiColombo, Juno and JUICE, derived from the HIGeoCAT catalogue of RAL Space using the SSEF30 geometric model. It was built by Christian Möstl, Eva Weiler and Emma Davies of the Austrian Space Weather Office at GeoSphere Austria with David Barnes, Richard Harrison and Jackie Davies of RAL Space, released in May 2020 and updated in April 2025. The catalogue is accessible free on figshare and the helioforecast site as pandas and numpy pickles, JSON, CSV, XLSX, TXT, HDF5 and HTML under the MIT licence, with the source notebook on GitHub. Caveats: arrivals are modelled, not observed, the self-similar expanding fitting model has known timing errors, and the authors ask to be contacted about co-authorship for publications. It supports CME arrival-time validation and event selection for geomagnetic storm impact studies on power grids and satellites; related records are DONKI and the NOAA WSA-Enlil model.
